verdict.rationale: Hightouch lets marketers build reusable 'Models' via SQL/dbt (which could compute traits like LTV) and use these traits to build audiences and journeys in a no-code UI (docs-2, docs-23, docs-24, docs-35). However, there is no explicit documentation of built-in predictive scoring models for churn, LTV, or purchase propensity — the closest related feature, AI Decisioning, is reinforcement-learning based message/channel/timing optimization, not a general predictive-score computation engine (docs-14, docs-45, docs-46). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of native predictive-score models (LTV, churn, propensity) as opposed to user-authored SQL traits, and evidence these specific score types are directly usable as audience filters.
